design.assumption: IID primary paired outcomes conditional on full past; bounded stopping time; each processed item counted; no optional rejection causes primary log E to fall below its first-futility-crossing floor.
design.original_evidence: docs/galahad/evidence/sequential-gate-sim-v1.json is immutable; its outcomes are not read by this calculation
design.scope: Current fixed-bet/futility/equal-wallet family with arbitrary bounded item cap and additional vetoes; not all sequential gates.
design.threshold_rationale: Prospective usefulness criterion: retain at least four out of five genuinely beneficial proposals in expectation, unlike prior zero of 100. A design target, not a clinical or statistical standard.
